nodes.description: Address of the multi-signature wallet authorized to change admin/multiSig.
Admin address allowed to configure oracles and token mappings.
ETH/USD Chainlink aggregator address used as reference price.
BNB/USD Chainlink aggregator address used as reference price.
Mapping token => Chainlink aggregator used to price that token.
Mapping of cached Price structs (price, expiration); declared but never written or read in this version, dead storage.
Mapping token => bool, marks tokens whose aggregator already returns a USD price.
initialize(address _multiSig): sets multiSig and admin = msg.sender, guarded by the initializer modifier.
receive() external payable: accepts plain ETH transfers without any logic.
setMultiSig(address): replaces multiSig, restricted by onlyMultiSig.
setAdmin(address): replaces admin, restricted by onlyMultiSig.
isEthOrBnB(address): returns true for ETH/BNB sentinel addresses.
get(address): public price entry point, resolves a mapped token to getChainLinkPrice.
setEthToUsdPriceOracle(address): sets the ETH/USD reference aggregator (onlyAdmin).
setBnbToUsdPriceOracle(address): sets the BNB/USD reference aggregator (onlyAdmin).
setTokenChainlinkMap(address,address): records a token aggregator (onlyAdmin).
setTokenChainlinkMaps(address[],address[]): batch version that loops over setTokenChainlinkMap (onlyAdmin).
setDirectTokenMap(address,bool): flags a token as directly quoted in USD (onlyAdmin).
setDirectTokenMaps(address[],bool): batch loop writing directTokenMap (onlyAdmin).
getChainLinkPrice(address): reads reference and token aggregators, scales prices by 1e10/1e8 and returns (price, bool).
getLatestRoundData(address): like getChainLinkPrice but also returns the oldest updatedAt of the aggregators read.
gets(address[]): batch view returning ChainlinkPrice structs for many tokens.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for the initializer assignment and for all onlyAdmin/onlyMultiSig authorization checks.
External call chainlinkContract.latestAnswer() on an admin-configured aggregator; price source is trusted and can be stale/manipulated.
External call chainlinkContract.latestRoundData() on an admin-configured aggregator; updatedAt is consumed without staleness validation.
Price scaling arithmetic basePrice.mul(1e10) and basePrice.mul(tokenPrice).div(1e8) on int256-derived values (SafeMath is used for the math itself).

tokens array parameter of setTokenChainlinkMaps.
chainlinks array parameter of setTokenChainlinkMaps.
token key parameter of setDirectTokenMap.
direct flag parameter of setDirectTokenMap.
tokens array parameter of setDirectTokenMaps.
direct flag parameter of setDirectTokenMaps.
token parameter of getChainLinkPrice(address).
token parameter of getLatestRoundData(address).
tokens array parameter of gets(address[]).
referenceOracle local selecting the ETH/USD or BNB/USD aggregator.
chainlinkContract local AggregatorInterface instance used for external price reads.
basePrice local holding the raw int256 answer of the reference aggregator.
tokenPrice local holding the raw int256 answer of the token aggregator.
updatedAt local holding the timestamp returned by the reference aggregator.
latest local, the minimum of the two aggregator update timestamps.
n local, the length of the tokens array in gets.
res local result array of ChainlinkPrice structs in gets.
